messages.subject: How to use the code to analysis the data search from tair?
messages.subject_clean: How to use the code to analysis the data search from tair?
messages.body_plain:
Code:
library(MSstatsPTM)
library(MSstats)
library(data.table)

path_pro <- "/Users/PRO_1.tsv"
path_phos <- "/Users/PHOS_2.tsv"
path_fasta <- "/Users?TAIR10_pep.txt"

raw_ptm_df <- fread(path_phos)
raw_protein_df <- fread(path_pro)

ptm_proteins <- unique(raw_ptm_df$PG.ProteinAccessions)
raw_protein_df <- raw_protein_df[PG.ProteinAccessions %in% ptm_proteins, ]

raw_ptm_df[is.na <http://is.na>(R.Replicate) | R.Replicate == "" | R.Replicate == 0, R.Replicate := R.FileName]
raw_protein_df[is.na <http://is.na>(R.Replicate) | R.Replicate == "" | R.Replicate == 0, R.Replicate := R.FileName]

gc()

annot <- unique(rbind(
raw_ptm_df[, .(Run = R.FileName, Condition = R.Condition, BioReplicate = R.Replicate)],
raw_protein_df[, .(Run = R.FileName, Condition = R.Condition, BioReplicate = R.Replicate)]
))

msstats_input <- SpectronauttoMSstatsPTMFormat(
raw_ptm_df,
annotation = annot,
protein_input = raw_protein_df,
fasta_path = path_fasta,
use_unmod_peptides = TRUE,
mod_id = "\[Phospho \(STY\)\]",
fasta_protein_name = "uniprot_iso"
)

PS:The entry of At4g08850 in uniprot is Q8VZG8.

messages.subject_clean: MSstats Plus error message for model fit
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

After seeing the last message about MSstats Plus, I decided to check it out. I definitely got some interesting results and want to use it more often. However, I am not able to check the model fit. When I Try:
                    #Check Model Fit
                    health_info = CheckDataHealth(msstats_input)
                    skew_score = health_info[[2]]

I got the following error:
                 Error in CheckDataHealth(msstats_input) :
                 could not find function "CheckDataHealth"

Also, I am currently using the "FGShapeQualityScore(MS2)", the FGShapeQualityScore(MS1) and the EGDeltaRT metrics for MSstats Plus. Are there any others I should add that are as important?

Thank you,

Roneldine

messages.subject: Re: MSstats Plus error message for model fit
messages.subject_clean: MSstats Plus error message for model fit
messages.body_plain:
Hi Roneldine,

CheckDataHealth should be an exported function by MSstatsConvert. Can you try to run `MSstatsConvert::CheckDataHealth` and see if you get the same error?

In terms of columns used in the model, I have found that "FGShapeQualityScore(MS2)", the FGShapeQualityScore(MS1) and the EGDeltaRT are the best metrics at the moment. There may be others that provide additional insight, however I think these three give a good baseline of peak quality.

Devon

messages.body_plain:
Hi Maithreyan,

A few questions:
- What is the size of your RAM on your computer in GB?
- What is the size of your dataset in GB?

There might be a problem with an inefficient way of how we handle the new DIANN 2.0 format, but want to confirm it's not a problem with your computer running out of memory.

Thanks,
Tony
